apex-metrics.title: Proposal: Apex Metrics Website Strategy & Phase-One Build
apex-metrics.executive_summary: Apex Metrics needs clearer category positioning and a website that converts research traffic into qualified conversations. This proposal scopes a diagnose-and-build engagement that delivers message architecture, core page narrative, SEO foundation, and a marketing-owned phase-one build — with optional ongoing support after launch.
apex-metrics.strategy_snapshot: Strategy call evidence points to differentiation pressure, PDF-driven sales workarounds, and limited marketing autonomy on the current site. A phased approach matches budget comfort while protecting the spring launch window.
apex-metrics.scope_snapshot: Three phases: Diagnose & Message Architecture → Core Narrative & SEO Foundation → Phase-One Build. Excludes brand identity overhaul, paid media, and product engineering. Optional retainer available post-launch.
apex-metrics.investment_summary: Phase-one investment: $36,000 USD after courtesy discount (required services subtotal $38,000). Optional ongoing support at $3,500/month is listed separately and not included in the package total.
next_steps: Approve this proposal and confirm phase-one start date
Share brand guidelines, CMS access, and analytics credentials
Schedule positioning workshop with economic buyer and marketing lead
Kick off Diagnose phase within five business days of approval
apex-metrics.closing_note: SimpliCreative prepares the work; your team remains the decision owner. This draft is for internal review before client presentation.

why_this_recommendation.title: Address the underlying friction first
why_this_recommendation.detail: The call shows that Apex needs clearer differentiation and a stronger buyer path before a full build can solve the right problem.

why_this_recommendation.title: Support qualified opportunities, not traffic alone
why_this_recommendation.detail: The scope connects message architecture, core-page copy, SEO, and measurement to the stated goal of increasing qualified opportunities.

why_this_recommendation.title: Restore marketing autonomy
why_this_recommendation.detail: The phase-one build includes reusable, marketing-owned components so campaign work does not depend on engineering tickets.

why_this_recommendation.title: Respect the current investment decision
why_this_recommendation.detail: A phased package gives leadership a scoped first commitment while keeping optional ongoing support separate.

apex-metrics.knowledge_note: Generated using SimpliCreative's current approved services, pricing, positioning, and proposal standards.

fast_readiness.label: Flexible
fast_readiness.finding: Marketing needs to publish and update pages without engineering tickets.
fast_readiness.suggested_action: Confirm CMS, reusable page modules, and the approval workflow.

fast_readiness.label: Accessible
fast_readiness.finding: Responsive behavior, accessibility baseline, and performance have not been validated in this call.
fast_readiness.suggested_action: Run accessibility, responsive, and performance review during discovery.

fast_readiness.label: Strategic
fast_readiness.finding: Positioning and the core site narrative do not explain differentiation or the buyer path clearly enough.
fast_readiness.suggested_action: Build message architecture, conversion paths, and search-ready content structure.

fast_readiness.label: Trackable
fast_readiness.finding: The team wants qualified opportunities, but first-touch-to-conversion measurement is not defined.
fast_readiness.suggested_action: Define analytics events, attribution fields, and reporting for qualified opportunities.
